message.content:
## Reading
MechanicLens — repair estimate  
Document: estimate  
Reading: Standard 4 · Check 1 · Question this 3

## Anatomy
| Line | Plain-English name | What it claims to cover | Amount |
|---|---|---|---:|
| “30,000-mile service package — required” | Maintenance service package | A service package due at 30,000 miles; the included services are not listed. | 189.00 |
| “Safety inspection — recommended” | Safety inspection | An inspection; the estimate does not say what it covers. | 65.00 |
| “Per TSB 21-045, reprogram transmission control module” | Transmission control module reprogramming | Reprogramming under the cited technical service bulletin. | 145.00 |
| “Water pump” | Water pump part | A water pump part; the estimate does not say what test led to it or explicitly describe replacement. | 165.00 |
| “Core charge” | Core charge | A charge possibly tied to returning an old part; the estimate does not identify the core or explain any credit. | 45.00 |
| “Labor — 2.0 hr @ 120.00/hr” | Labor | Two labor hours at the stated rate; the operation those hours cover is not named. | 240.00 |
| “Note: work in item 3 authorized verbally by phone” | Authorization note | Says the reprogramming work was authorized verbally; it does not say what was agreed or by whom. | — |
| “Sales tax 7%” | Sales tax | Tax at the stated rate. The listed charges before tax total 849.00; 7% is 59.43. | 59.43 |
| “TOTAL” | Estimate total | The listed amounts add to the stated total. | 908.43 |

## Scope check
The reprogramming is described as addressing the hard shifting. The water pump could relate to the coolant warning, but the estimate does not state the test or finding that supports it. The 30,000-mile package and safety inspection are not linked in the estimate to either reported symptom; those lines are labeled **Question this** on that scope basis.

## Labels
| Line | Label | Reason (quoted) |
|---|---|---|
| “30,000-mile service package — required” | Question this | The estimate does not connect this maintenance package to the hard shifting or coolant warning. |
| “Safety inspection — recommended” | Question this | The estimate does not connect this inspection to either reported symptom. |
| “Per TSB 21-045, reprogram transmission control module” | Standard | The line describes reprogramming and gives a TSB number; it corresponds to the reported hard shifting. |
| “Water pump” | Standard | A named part and amount are shown; the estimate does not state the diagnostic basis. |
| “Core charge” | Question this | The estimate does not explain which core is involved or how it is credited. |
| “Labor — 2.0 hr @ 120.00/hr” | Standard | Labor hours and rate are shown. The operation covered is not stated. |
| “Note: work in item 3 authorized verbally by phone” | Check | The estimate records verbal authorization; confirm what work was authorized and by whom. |
| “Sales tax 7%” | Standard | A tax rate is stated, and the amount matches 7% of the listed pre-tax charges. |

## Questions to ask
1. What test or finding led to the water pump line, and does it specifically relate to the coolant warning? — a good answer sounds like: a named test or observed finding and how it supports the proposed work.
2. What services are included in the 30,000-mile package, and why is it marked required? — a good answer sounds like: an itemized list and the reason each service is due.
3. What does the safety inspection cover, and did it identify any specific issue? — a good answer sounds like: the inspection scope and any findings, separated from the reported symptoms.
4. What part does the core charge apply to, and what happens to the charge if the old part is returned? — a good answer sounds like: the specific core and the shop’s stated credit or return terms.
5. What exactly was authorized verbally for item 3, and who recorded that authorization? — a good answer sounds like: the agreed work and a clear account of who authorized it and when.
6. Which operation does the two labor hours cover, and does it include the reprogramming or any overlapping work? — a good answer sounds like: the work assigned to the hours and whether any time is shared with another line.

## Decision
The question script is here for you to use; you decide what to do. Photograph the estimate, note what was promised verbally and by whom, and keep the paperwork chain.

## Needs confirmation
[CONFIRM: What services the 30,000-mile package includes.]  
[CONFIRM: The finding supporting the water pump work.]  
[CONFIRM: What the core charge applies to and its credit terms.]  
[CONFIRM: Which operation the two labor hours cover.]  
[CONFIRM: The details of the verbal authorization for item 3.]
